caption_used: Massive activation values across layers under baseline conditions, showing four component signals. The ffn_residual (red solid) and attn_residual (orange dotted) lines rise sharply at layer 5 to approximately 1400, with ffn_residual maintaining values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before declining. The attn_residual closely mirrors ffn_residual but with a one-layer rightward shift. The ffn_output (green dash-dot) exhibits periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching peak values of approximately 800. The attn_output (blue dashed) remains near zero throughout all layers, with no notable increase at any point in the network. The data indicates that massive activations in the baseline are driven primarily by the feed-forward network residual stream, with attention outputs contributing negligibly.

The horizontal axis (x-axis) is labeled "Layer" and spans from 0 to 22, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 22), using a linear scale. The vertical axis (y-axis) is labeled "Max Activation Value" and ranges from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200 (0, 200, 400, ..., 1600), also on a linear scale. Four distinct lines are plotted: "attn_output" (blue dashed), "attn_residual" (orange dotted), "ffn_output" (green dash-dot), and "ffn_residual" (red solid), as indicated in the legend positioned in the upper center of the plot.

The red solid line ("ffn_residual") remains at 0 from layer 0 to layer 5, then rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, maintaining values between 1400 and 1600 from layer 5 to layer 20, before dropping sharply to around 400 at layer 22. The orange dotted line ("attn_residual") follows a similar pattern but is shifted one layer to the right: it remains at 0 until layer 6, rises to approximately 1400 at layer 6, stays near 1400–1600 until layer 21, and then drops to around 500 at layer 22. The green dash-dot line ("ffn_output") remains near 0 until layer 5, where it spikes to approximately 800, then drops back to near 0; it repeats this pattern at layer 13 and again at layer 22, with each spike reaching approximately 800. The blue dashed line ("attn_output") remains at or near 0 across all layers from 0 to 22, with no visible increase or spike at any point. The lines are visually distinct by color and line style, and there are no markers on the lines. The chart uses a white background with black axes and gridlines.
